topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This topic frames the lecture by introducing cancer evolution concepts and outlining the session's key learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective advantages that drive clonal tumor development.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the organization of tissue hierarchies and present experimental evidence for cancer stem cells and cells of origin across different malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how environmental promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma enable cancer development and offer targets for therapy.

topics.label: Experimental and computational tools for analyzing tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the experimental and bioinformatic methods used to investigate tumor heterogeneity, clonal timing, and spatial microenvironments.

topics.label: Multifactorial evolutionary framework of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates mutational, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a comprehensive model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides the lecture's closing remarks and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
